metadata.notes: Editing endpoint of gpt-image-2.5 (flare) on fal.ai, reachable through /v1/images/edits or the image generation path with fal's image_urls param. Prices include one input image and live in keyed entries fal_ai/{quality}/{width}-x-{height}/openai/gpt-image-2.5/flare/edit. This flat entry is the fallback for the default edit request (quality=high, image_size=auto, inferred from the input image, priced as 1024x768 high)

metadata.comment: Ark bills per output token, not per second: tokens = width * height * 24 * seconds / 1024, so a per-second rate per resolution tier is exact for the 16:9 geometry Ark publishes (1280x720 is 21600 tokens/s; the 480p frame is 864x496, 10044 tokens/s, not the tier's nominal 854x480). List 46 CNY per million tokens at 480p and 720p, 51 at 1080p, and 26 at 4k without a video input, matching Ark's per-resolution table and its 1080p and 4k 16:9 examples of 2.48 and 5.05 CNY/s, converted at 7.0 CNY/USD like the other volcengine entries. Clips of 4-15s; 4k is exclusive to this tier. Requests with a video input bill at a lower rate per token and are rejected, since their cost is not known at create time. provider_specific_entry.volcengine_video_frames is the frame Ark renders per resolution tier and ratio, verified with ffprobe at 480p for every ratio and at 720p for 16:9 and 4:3; the other 720p ratios are from the Seedance 2.0 model card.

metadata.comment: Ark bills per output token, not per second: tokens = width * height * 24 * seconds / 1024, so a per-second rate per resolution tier is exact for the 16:9 geometry Ark publishes (1280x720 is 21600 tokens/s). List 70 CNY per million tokens at 480p and 720p and 77 at 1080p without a video input, matching Ark's per-resolution table and its 1080p 16:9 example of 3.74 CNY/s, converted at 7.0 CNY/USD like the other volcengine entries.
